items.label: 手机随拍
items.prompt: Handheld phone at 1x, about 26mm equivalent, from ordinary standing height. Slight off-centre framing and a small natural tilt. Readable surroundings and broad depth of field, no artificial portrait-mode blur.
items.description: 手机1倍、轻微歪斜，背景可辨

items.label: 远处长焦
items.prompt: Photographed from across the public space using a 135mm telephoto perspective, with compressed distances and moderately softened background. Keep enough environmental context to understand the scene.
items.description: 远距离135mm，空间压缩与适度虚化

items.label: 前景遮挡
items.prompt: Observe from beside a pillar or other existing scene object using a 50mm perspective. One softly blurred foreground edge partially obscures the frame; keep the face and essential action visible.
items.description: 50mm，从现场物体旁观察，前景局部遮挡

items.label: 缝隙观察
items.prompt: Photograph through a gap between existing foreground objects in a public space with an 85mm perspective. Dark out-of-focus edges frame the subject asymmetrically without hiding the face.

items.label: 玻璃反射
items.prompt: Photograph the subject reflected in a public storefront window using a 50mm perspective. Subtle environmental reflections and faint double images coexist with a recognisable face.

items.label: 低机位环境
items.prompt: Photograph from roughly chair-seat height with a 28mm perspective, looking slightly upward. Retain natural body proportions and environmental foreground; frame the whole action without looking beneath clothing.
items.description: 28mm椅面高度，轻仰拍与环境前景
